query:
SELECT 
  YEAR(saleDate) as ano,
  MONTH(saleDate) as mes,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(finalAmount) as total
FROM sales 
WHERE saleType = 'DELIVERY'
  AND status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY YEAR(saleDate), MONTH(saleDate)
ORDER BY ano, mes
